newsitem.title: UK: Dlr/mark off highs in Europe, dlr/yen edges up.
newsitem.headline: Dlr/mark off highs in Europe, dlr/yen edges up.

text.p: 1408 GMT - Dollar/mark sturdy though off early 71-month peak. Dollar/yen edges higher with mark/yen as ailing mark pulls off lows. Sterling/mark off earlier near seven-year highs. Fed's Rivlin says inflation benign but upside risk outweighs downside, says tough call on whether to tighten further. Fed's Meyer, McDonough, say Fed must be pre-emptive. Dow buoyant.
